messages:
vivian: Heads up from today's onboarding: `redwoodctl` installed from our apt repo keeps loading 'demo' profile even when friends pass `--profile=onboard`.

vivian: Quick repro: `apt install redwoodctl`, create ~/.config/redwood/profile with `name: onboard`, then `redwoodctl localtest start --profile=onboard` -> starts with demo values.

jon: that's weird. can you run `REDWOOD_LOG=debug redwoodctl config resolved` and paste the resolver trace?

vivian: trace: 
```
[resolver] candidate: /etc/xdg/redwood/profile -> name: demo
[resolver] candidate: /home/vivian/.config/redwood/profile -> name: onboard
[resolver] requested_profile: onboard
[resolver] selected: demo (first-match)
```

vivian: looks like first-match wins. But CLI flag was passed.

tina: packaging team confirmed the postinst drops a demo profile at /etc/xdg/redwood/profile to help demo sandboxes. that's causing collisions. Packaging note filed.

packaging-bot: PKG-198 created: "avoid dropping profile into /etc/xdg on install; use /usr/share/redwood/examples instead".

jon: resolver bug too. rule should be: 1) if CLI requested_profile provided, search all candidate locations for an exact name match and prefer that; 2) else fall back to precedence order (env, XDG, home). currently first-match short-circuits.

vivian: workaround for the new hire: rename `/etc/xdg/redwood/profile` -> `/etc/xdg/redwood/profile.disabled` and restart localtest. unblocks them.

ci-bot: opened PR #1247 with resolver test and fix (scan-all-then-select logic). CI queued.

tina: I'll coordinate packaging change so we don't ship colliding demo names and add a note to the quickstart: "If localtest ignores your profile after apt install, check /etc/xdg/redwood/profile".

jon: thanks. low-risk fix, shipping soon. vivian: can you add the repro steps to DEVEX ticket?"
